frontier_protocol.diagnostic.no_cell: No Stabilization Cell or Stored Cell Time
frontier_protocol.tooltip.stabilizer.sum: Create-powered infection containment infrastructure. Requires rotation and Stabilization Cells.
frontier_protocol.tooltip.stabilizer.rot: Suppresses new Spore infection across the full dimension height.
frontier_protocol.tooltip.stabilizer.cle: Existing infection is cleaned progressively while ACTIVE.
frontier_protocol.tooltip.stabilizer.def: Does not block hostile mobs or replace physical defenses.
frontier_protocol.tooltip.cell.summary: Finished consumable for every Stabilizer tier.
frontier_protocol.tooltip.cell.details: Produced by Deploying Stabilization Compound onto an Iron Sheet. Consumed when a powered Stabilizer begins a new operating duration.
frontier_protocol.tooltip.compound.detai: Produced by heated Create Mixing. Must be sealed into a Stabilization Cell before use and cannot power a Stabilizer directly.
frontier_protocol.ponder.tag.containment: Create-powered infrastructure for suppressing Spore infection.
frontier_protocol.ponder.stabilizer_oper: Connect Create rotational power to the Stabilizer shaft.
Supply Stabilization Cells continuously with Create logistics.
At the required RPM, ACTIVE suppression and progressive cleanup begin.
Lost power or supply enters GRACE_PERIOD: suppression remains, but cleanup pauses.
When grace expires the machine is OFFLINE. Restore power and stored Cell time to resume.
frontier_protocol.ponder.stabilizer_cove: Each tile represents one chunk, centered on the Stabilizer placement chunk.
Tier 1 covers 1x1, Tier 2 covers 3x3, and Tier 3 covers 5x5 chunks by default.
Coverage spans the full dimension height. If one overlapping Stabilizer stops, another source keeps shared chunks suppressed.
Suppression does not stop hostile mobs. Build walls, lighting, and physical defenses separately.
Initial Overworld spawn is a separate permanent 5x5 suppression source by default. It needs no Cell or rotation, performs no cleanup, and does not stop mobs.
frontier_protocol.ponder.stabilizer_prod: Heated Mixing combines Spore Biomass Block, Redstone, Charcoal, and Water into Stabilization Compound.
Deploy Compound onto an Iron Sheet to seal a Stabilization Cell. Compound cannot power a Stabilizer directly.
Mechanical Crafters produce Tier 1, then upgrade Tier 1 to Tier 2 and Tier 2 to Tier 3.
Every tier consumes the same Stabilization Cell. Automate production and continuous delivery with Create logistics.
